Name: AutoRecMush
Author: coopverse
Description:
Description AutoRecMush, recolhe sozinho os cogumelos da caverna da fazenda (a escolha do Demetrius) e guarda num baú. Você não precisa entrar na caverna todo dia.
Place a real chest in the mushroom cave once. Ready mushrooms are collected at the start of each day, and again if you walk in. Fruit-bat cave, mushroom logs, and the dehydrator are not handled.
Installation instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download AutoRecMush.zip and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Confirm you have Mods/AutoRecMush/manifest.json.[/*]
[*]Choose the mushroom cave when Demetrius asks.[/*]
[*]Place a wooden, stone, or big chest in the cave (not a barrel or dresser).[/*]
[*]Sleep. Mushrooms go into the chest overnight.[/*]
[/list]Main features
[list]
[*]Collects the six farm-cave mushroom boxes automatically[/*]
[*]Stores them in any wood/stone/big chest you placed in the cave[/*]
[*]Extra mushrooms overflow into the next chest if the first is full[/*]
[*]Works without entering the cave (also collects when you walk in)[/*]
[*]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support[/*]
[*]Portuguese and English[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]Mushroom cave (Demetrius)[/*]
[*]A real chest in the cave[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional[/*]
[/list]Thanks to the SMAPI team.
